raw.query: WITH comparable AS (SELECT c.window_name, c.lead_s, c.forecast_model, MIN(c.numerator_worker_seconds) AS numerator_worker_seconds FROM provenance.v_dim AS d JOIN provenance.v_cost_ratio AS c ON c.run_id = d.run_id WHERE d.is_current AND c.is_current AND c.forecast_model IN ('chronos','toto','timesfm') AND c.lead_s = 30 GROUP BY c.window_name, c.lead_s, c.forecast_model), three_way AS (SELECT window_name, lead_s FROM comparable GROUP BY window_name, lead_s HAVING COUNT(*) = 3) SELECT c.window_name, c.lead_s, jsonb_object_agg(c.forecast_model, c.numerator_worker_seconds ORDER BY c.forecast_model) AS worker_seconds FROM comparable AS c JOIN three_way AS t USING (window_name, lead_s) GROUP BY c.window_name, c.lead_s ORDER BY c.window_name
